settings.title: Settings
settings.background.title: Keep running when closed
settings.background.hint: Closing the window keeps the music playing and leaves the app in the system tray. Turn it off and closing the window quits the app.
settings.background.no_tray: Unavailable: this system has no system tray.
settings.mini.title: Mini player
settings.mini.hint: A small window with the controls when you minimize or close the app. Requires keeping it running in the background.
settings.rewind.title: Rewind in the mini player
settings.rewind.hint: How far back the rewind button jumps.
settings.autostart.title: Start with Windows
settings.autostart.hint: Opens when you turn on the computer, minimized to the tray without showing the window.
settings.queue.title: Autoplay queue
settings.queue.hint: When you pick a song, the queue fills itself with recommendations and keeps extending as you reach the end. Off, only what you pick plays.
settings.radio.title: Songs when you pick a song
settings.radio.hint: The first batch arrives with the song and the rest loads in the background until the chosen size is reached. A large queue uses no noticeable memory.
settings.memory.title: Free memory in the background
settings.memory.hint: Drops thumbnails and lists while the window is closed or minimized; they reload when you come back.
settings.memory.free_hint: Returns to the system the memory the app is not using. It only grows back as needed.
settings.playback.restore_queue_hint: Brings back the queue and the song from last time.
settings.playback.media_keys_hint: Pause, next and previous from the keyboard, even with the app in the background. If another app already uses them, this turns itself off.
settings.playback.notifications_hint: Shows a notification when the window is hidden or minimized.
settings.language.app_hint: The app's menus, buttons and messages. Applied after a restart.
settings.language.restart_message: The new language will be applied when the app restarts. Your queue is kept.
settings.language.content_hint: Text that YouTube Music returns on Home, Explore and searches.
settings.theme.title: Theme
settings.thumbnails.quality_hint: “Automatic” already matches your screen resolution. “High” requests larger images on large or 4K monitors; “Low” shrinks them to save memory and data.
settings.thumbnails.cache_hint: How many are kept ready so they are not downloaded again while scrolling. A lower number uses less RAM but reloads more often.
settings.lyrics.order_note: Tried in this order; the first synced lyrics win, otherwise the first one that answers.
settings.lyrics.key_hint: Without a key it only returns what it already has cached. Its authors hand out keys per project.
settings.lyrics.romanized_hint: Shows a second line with the lyrics transcribed to the Latin alphabet when the original language does not use it, via the Unison API (unison.boidu.dev). Applies to the next lyrics requested.
settings.cache.title: Thumbnails and temporary data
settings.cache.hint: Downloaded again when needed. Does not delete your session, your playlists or your queue.
settings.account.signed_in_hint: Signed in, you see your YouTube Music library and playlists.
settings.account.signed_out_hint: Without signing in you can listen, but you don't see your library or playlists.
settings.log.title: Error log
settings.log.hint: If something fails, send this file to help find the problem. It does not include your session or your data.
settings.theme.restart_message: The new theme will be applied when the app restarts. Your queue is kept.
